preparationHint: First clarify the goal, then review the plan. Execution agents start only after you approve it. Questions and planning count toward this team's budget.
preparationWorking: Jarvis is preparing your questions or plan. You can return to this draft later.
noClarificationNeeded: Your goal already contains enough detail. Jarvis can prepare a plan for your review.
delegateClarificationAnswer: Propose a sensible choice consistent with my original goal, and make that assumption explicit in the plan for my review.
planCanExpand: The lead can plan further stages within this goal and your chosen limits.
approvePlanHint: Starting approves this saved plan and its limits. No execution agents have started yet.
preparationLaunched: Plan approved. The swarm has started.
goalRequired: Enter a goal or load a prompt file.
goalExample: Describe the result you want. Jarvis will work out the steps.
promptFile: Choose or drop a prompt file (.txt or .md)
promptFileInvalid: Choose a UTF-8 text or Markdown file with up to 20,000 characters (80 KB). Your current prompt has been kept.
automaticHint: Jarvis asks a few focused questions and prepares a plan. You review it before the team starts working.
defaultLimitHint: The swarm stops at its limits. Adjust them under Options.
simulationHint: The lead coordinates, workers execute, and evidence verifies the result. This view follows actual team activity.
skillProgress: Verified evidence toward the next level
skillEvidenceHint: Open a contribution to inspect its original task and evidence.
recheckHint: Replay the original deterministic proof within a 45-second limit. Passing grants no additional credit. Other review methods need a newly authorized review budget.
title: Ultra Agent Swarm
subtitle: Give Jarvis a goal. It plans the work and builds the team.
empty: Create a team to turn a goal into coordinated, verifiable work.
name: Team name
acceptance: What must the final result demonstrate?
domains: Allowed domains (comma separated; empty allows public sites)
planHint: The lead creates a task plan and verifies the result against your goal and acceptance criteria.
uncertainty: Levels reflect verified team contributions. Low sample counts carry greater uncertainty.
noWebgl: 3D is unavailable. Every team status, task and control remains available below.
retryHint: Retry storage recovery, then refresh. Existing team data is retained.
aggregation: Large teams are grouped. Choose a group for a bounded view of its workers.
bounded: Showing a bounded page. Use the inspector pages for more records.
providerUnavailable: No inference provider is available. Configure a provider in API Keys before starting.
invalidBudget: Use positive whole-number limits and an optional USD amount with up to six decimal places.
stopHint: Stop prevents new work and asks current calls to finish or cancel. Reserved exposure remains visible until reconciled.
finalWorld: Completed team view · no live workers
previewTruncated: Preview limited to 100 KB. Download the full artifact.
distributedHint: Local teams work without these services. Distributed teams need managed PostgreSQL, Redis and S3-compatible storage.
teamUnavailableHint: Team storage could not be read. Current status and world data are unknown. Retry recovery below.
secretHint: Credentials are write-only. Empty fields preserve existing credentials.
proposalHint: Review a specialist's proposal and choose its budget and policy. Approval creates a team; Start launches its work.
resumeApprovalHint: Resume with the settings already approved. These settings remain fixed during recovery.
approvalSpecMissing: The saved approval settings are unavailable. Refresh to retry recovery.
proposalCreated: Proposal approved. The team is ready to start.
assignmentScopeHint: Only the specialist's name, title, focus and the input shown here are shared with this team. Personal history, files and permissions remain separate.
noAssignedSpecialists: No specialist assignments on this page.
specialistAssigned: Specialist assigned with the approved input.
specialistRevoked: Team membership revoked. Personal records are unchanged.
noBackups: No saved backups for this team.
restoreHint: Import a backup downloaded from Jarvis. Restoring never starts work automatically.
replaceTeamHint: The backup must belong to this team. Current work stops and the existing workspace is kept as a recovery copy. Published results remain available.
backupRestored: Backup restored. Review the team before resuming work.
retentionHint: Remove expired messages, unused objects, saved backups and replacement recovery copies older than 30 days. Tasks, evidence and published results are retained.
applyRetention: Clean up data older than 30 days
deleteHint: Permanently delete this team's workspace and stop its work. Completed publications remain available. Local team identities stay reserved here; restore their backups in another instance. Use Archive to keep the team available in this instance.
distributedDeleteHint: Objects in distributed storage follow your bucket's retention policy after this team is removed.
